scripts.build:app: pnpm run css && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && env -u NO_COLOR trunk build --release --config ./crates/app/Trunk.toml
scripts.check: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo test -p poster-gen-core && cargo check -p poster-gen-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && pnpm run css
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:worker && wrangler deploy
